EntitlementsCausalParent.title: EntitlementsCausalParent
EntitlementsCausalParent.description: Causal parent of an entitlements/billing event: an earlier event in the same stream (the W010 shape).

BillingStreamId.title: BillingStreamId
BillingStreamId.description: Opaque billing-stream identity: "stream:billing-" followed by a lowercase slug (the W010 stream grammar; one stream per billing account).

EntitlementsStreamId.title: EntitlementsStreamId
EntitlementsStreamId.description: Opaque entitlements-stream identity: "stream:entitlements-" followed by a lowercase slug (the W010 stream grammar; one stream per entitlement).

EntitlementsEventSequence.title: EntitlementsEventSequence
EntitlementsEventSequence.description: One entitlements/billing event sequence number: 1-based, contiguous per stream.
